name: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
s: The Boss Baby brings his big brother Tim to the office to teach him the art of business in this animated series sprung from the hit film.

paragraphs.text: The Boss Baby: Back in Business is an American animated comedy television series produced by DreamWorks Animation Television. The show is based on the 2017 film The Boss Baby, loosely based on the 2010 picture book of the same name written by Marla Frazee. The series premiered on Netflix on April 6, 2018. JP Karliak voices The Boss Baby, replacing Alec Baldwin, while Pierce Gagnon replaces Miles Bakshi as Timothy Leslie Templeton; Eric Bell Jr. reprised his role from the film, as The Triplets.
